name: asd-ste100-english
description: Write and rewrite English in ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) style, adapted from the MIT-licensed danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill: short sentences, active voice, one instruction per sentence, no semicolons, one word for one meaning, and hedges kept intact. Use for tool descriptions, error messages, prompts, inter-agent instructions, procedures and status reports, or when the user asks for STE, STE100 or "80% STE". Norwegian domain terms stay Norwegian.

interface.shortDescription: Write English that an agent or a non-native reader cannot misread, with the rules of ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English).
